title: Coding Agent Value Lab
subtitle: Independent analysis of coding models, harnesses, reasoning levels, costs, and subscription efficiency.
positioning: Benchmarks tell you who scored highest. This lab tells you what to use.
status: Research pipeline ready · first verified dataset pending

recommendation.title: The recommendation appears when the evidence is ready.
recommendation.summary: The renderer is live, but it will not invent a winner. Add verified benchmark rows and the page will calculate the practical default from the research JSON.

insights.label: Evidence policy
insights.title: No benchmark row enters the recommendation without its context.
insights.body: Model, harness, reasoning effort, benchmark version, run configuration, evidence class, and source are separate fields in the data contract.

insights.label: Static architecture
insights.title: The page is a renderer, not a second research database.
insights.body: A scheduled pipeline can update current.json and snapshots. Gatsby rebuilds the same interface from the new evidence.

insights.label: Decision lens
insights.title: The useful answer is a configuration, not a model name.
insights.body: Value depends on capability, cost, quota consumption, speed, reliability, task fit, harness, and evidence quality.

methodology.summary: The Value Lab keeps benchmark versions isolated, labels evidence quality, preserves uncertainty, and distinguishes measured performance from estimated developer value.
assumptions: Subscription-window estimates require first-party or adequately documented quota observations.
Raw scores from different benchmark versions are not directly comparable.
A missing value remains missing rather than being silently imputed.
